compasssurgicalpartners-compass-surgical.title: CNA
compasssurgicalpartners-compass-surgical.description: Location: Coastal Virginia Surgery Center Address: 580 City Center Blvd Ste 300, Newport News, VA 23606 Website: Coastal Virginia Surgery Center https://coastalvirginiasurgerycenter.com/ Coastal Virginia Surgery Center is an ambulatory surgery center located in Newport News, VA. With two operating rooms and two procedure rooms, the center provides high-quality, cost-effective outpatient surgical and procedural care primarily for Orthopedics, Spine, Podiatry, and Pain Management. Owned and operated in partnership with BSMH and Compass Surgical Partners (an ASC Management organization), the center combines advanced technology with compassionate, patient-centered care in a convenient setting. Role Summary: Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) assists staff and registered nurses in providing preoperative and postoperative patient care in the surgery center. Supports patient comfort, safety, and efficient workflow through direct patient assistance, basic clinical tasks, and maintaining a clean environment. Hours: • Monday–Friday schedule (30-32 hours/week) • No nights, weekends, holidays, or call What You’ll Do: - Assist with patient admissions and preparation as directed by the RN. - Help patients change, secure belongings, and transport within the facility. - Obtain and record vital signs (BP, temperature, pulse, and respirations). - Assist with patient mobility, bathroom needs, and comfort measures. - Provide nourishment to patients in the recovery area. - Perform CLIA-waived testing (e.g., pregnancy and blood glucose). - Remove IVs as directed and transport lab specimens. - Maintain a clean and safe patient care environment, including terminal cleaning of stretchers, recliners, and equipment. - Use appropriate infection control practices and personal protective equipment. - Communicate effectively with patients, escorts, and team members. - Demonstrate reliability, professionalism, and positive teamwork. - Manage time effectively and maintain adequate supplies. - Assist with inventory, logistical tasks, and other duties assigned. - Participate in quality improvement and maintain high patient satisfaction. What You’ll Bring: - High school diploma or GED. - Completion of a Medical Assistant program or 3–5 years of patient aide experience. - CNA I & II certification required. - BLS certification required What We Offer: - No nights, weekends, holidays, or call - Competitive hourly rate and benefits package - Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), and PTO - Supportive, collaborative environment

jobgether-jobgether:lever:4052fa26-ef5c-.title: Head of Finance
jobgether-jobgether:lever:4052fa26-ef5c-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Finance based in Belgium. This is a senior leadership opportunity to build and lead a modern Finance function within a fast-growing international payments environment. You will own management reporting, financial control, budgeting, settlements, cash-flow planning, and financial process optimization. The role combines strategic leadership with hands-on ownership of financial models, reporting logic, reconciliations, and operational controls. You will partner closely with Data, Development, Treasury, and executive leadership to turn complex financial information into actionable business insights. A key focus will be replacing manual processes with reliable, automated reporting and scalable financial workflows. You will also oversee financial operations across multiple legal entities, currencies, products, merchants, and payment methods. This role is ideal for an experienced finance leader who thrives on ownership, transformation, and working in a data-driven, international environment. Own end-to-end management reporting, including P&L, Cash Flow Statement, Balance Sheet, plan-vs-actual analysis, and profitability reporting across products, merchants, payment methods, and legal entities. Build and maintain the budgeting and forecasting cycle, including operating budgets, payment calendars, cash-flow forecasts, gap analysis, scenario planning, and obligation tracking. Design and operate a robust financial control framework covering regular reconciliations, discrepancy classification, resolution SLAs, approval workflows, audit trails, and manual adjustment controls. Manage merchant settlements, including settlement calculations, provider fees, minimum fees, surcharges, refunds, chargebacks, FX conversions, and balance transfers. Oversee finance across multiple legal entities, currencies, and intercompany transactions, including consolidated reporting and preparation of information for statutory accounting and external audits. Serve as the business owner for financial automation by defining financial logic, KPIs, formulas, data sources, requirements, and acceptance criteria for dashboards and reports. Collaborate with Data Analysts, Data Engineers, and Development teams to validate financial outputs, identify discrepancies, and prioritize automation initiatives based on business impact. Lead, structure, and develop the Finance team by defining responsibilities, hiring where needed, establishing accountability, and driving continuous process improvement. Report financial performance, risks, forecasts, and business insights to the CEO, founders, and senior leadership in clear, commercially focused language. Establish clear operating boundaries between Finance, Treasury, and Data while maintaining effective collaboration across these functions. Develop a scalable Finance function capable of supporting growth across multiple markets, entities, currencies, and transaction volumes. Requirements 8+ years of experience in Finance, including at least 3 years managing a finance team or function. Professional background in fintech, payments/PSP, acquiring, EMI, banking, crypto payments, or another high-volume transactional business. Proven experience building or transforming financial processes, particularly moving from manual Excel-based reporting toward automated data pipelines and reporting. Strong experience managing multiple legal entities, currencies, and intercompany operations. Hands-on ownership of P&L, Cash Flow, Balance Sheet, plan-vs-actual reporting, and financial forecasting. Ability to define financial metrics, establish standardized calculation methodologies, and develop unit economics and profitability analysis by product, customer, channel, or business line. southparkcommons-profound:ashbyhq:86863e.title: Information Security Analyst
southparkcommons-profound:ashbyhq:86863e.description: Profound is the marketing platform for the age of AI search. The way brands reach people is being rewritten — AI models like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Mode are now the answer layer between companies and their customers. We built the platform marketers use to understand, measure, and win in that world: the analytics, intelligence, and agent automation that turn AI search from a threat into a competitive advantage. We went from 0 to a $1B valuation in 18 months. Revenue grew 100x last year. Our customers include 15% of the Fortune 500 like Walmart, Wayfair and U.S. Bank, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. We are backed by Sequoia, Kleiner Perkins, LSVP, and Khosla Ventures — and we are moving fast enough that the people joining now are building the playbook everyone who comes after them will run. What You’ll Do - Own inbound customer security reviews from start to finish: complete security questionnaires and respond to RFPs and RFIs accurately and within the timelines our sales cycles demand - Act as the security point of contact during the sales process, working alongside the sales team to unblock deals and answer prospective customers’ security and privacy questions directly and credibly - Build and maintain reusable answer libraries and templates so each customer’s security review goes faster than the last - Build and improve AI-assisted workflows that cut the manual effort on each questionnaire and audit, so the function scales as our volume grows - Answer buyers' AI-trust questions (training-data handling/retention, subprocessors, data residency, our stance on ISO/IEC 42001, the EU AI Act, and NIST AI RMF), and flag the right internal owner when something's outside your call - Flag recurring themes in customer questions, objections, and new requirements, and collaborate with Information Security, Product, and Legal to eliminate gaps and duplicate effort - Help shape the function from the ground up: design the processes, workflows, and standards that the team will need to operate globally Who You Are - 1+ years of experience conducting customer-facing information security work or you come from a solutions engineering or sales engineering background - You are able to translate technical security and AI-governance controls into clear, customer-facing responses, exercising sound judgment about when to answer directly, when to add a caveat, and when to escalate - You can hold your own on calls when a prospect's security team challenges our answers, thinking on your feet while keeping the deal moving - You have real fluency in security and compliance. You're comfortable across frameworks like ISO 27001, ISO 42001, SOC 2, GDPR, and CCP - You are an avid user of AI tools. You already reach for AI in your daily work and are excited to use it to make security reviews faster and more consistent - You bring a customer-first mindset, sharp organization, and close attention to detail, even under tight deadlines It is a plus if you also have experience with: - Contract negotiation across DPAs, MSAs, security exhibits, subprocessor agreements, BAAs, and SLAs - Working with procurement and/or legal teams - Vendor risk management. We are a vendor, and most of our customers run vendor risk assessments on us, so understanding both sides of that process goes a long way Location This is an on-site role based in our Buenos Aires office, designed for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and meaningful impact. For this role, the expected base salary range is $50,000 to $70,000, depending on experience. Profound's total compensation package includes base salary, equity, and a full range of benefits and perks. Final compensation will depend on factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location, and will be determined during the interview process. Our recruiting team will share more details about the full compensation package and benefits as you move through hiring. Note: All official communication from Profo

strategichr-strategichr:greenhouse:79308.title: Part-Time Paralegal
strategichr-strategichr:greenhouse:79308.description: Career Opportunity: Part-Time Paralegal with The Ohio Justice and Policy Center in Cleveland, Ohio Are you passionate about creating fair, intelligent, and redemptive criminal justice systems? Do you want to support individuals seeking a second chance? If so, we want you to join our team. As a Part-Time Paralegal , you will support OJPC's Beyond Guilt Project, which advocates for the release of incarcerated individuals serving excessive or unjust sentences through parole advocacy, judicial release, resentencing efforts, and other legal mechanisms. As the operational backbone of the project, you will help support a docket of approximately 10-13 active client matters annually, working closely with attorneys to coordinate records gathering, develop rehabilitation portfolios and reentry plans, maintain case files, and help keep cases moving forward. In addition, as the Part-Time Paralegal you will: Support client intake, case development, records gathering, and case tracking for Beyond Guilt matters. Assemble rehabilitation portfolios and assist with developing reentry and release plans for clients seeking parole, judicial release, resentencing, or other forms of relief. Coordinate prison visits, maintain relationships with housing and service providers, and support communication with clients, families, and community partners. Assist attorneys with legal filings, exhibits, memoranda, submissions to the Parole Board, and other case preparation activities. Participate in case strategy discussions, provide input on client matters, and help maintain case files and deadlines within Clio and other case management systems. Support outreach, educational presentations, internship activities, and other OJPC projects as needed based on experience and organizational needs. QUALIFICATIONS: Paralegal experience, paralegal certification, or equivalent experience in legal, social services, reentry, or other related fields. Strong organizational, communication, and time-management skills with the ability to manage deadlines and multiple matters simultaneously. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with attorneys, staff, clients, families, community partners, and other stakeholders. Commitment to social justice and the ability to work respectfully and effectively with diverse populations, including individuals impacted by the criminal legal system. Experience with criminal legal system records, parole or post-conviction advocacy, reentry services, housing resources, or case management systems such as Clio is preferred. Personal experience with, or close proximity to, the criminal legal system is valued. Returning citizens are strongly encouraged to apply. The Ohio Justice & Policy Center creates fair, intelligent, and redemptive criminal justice systems through zealous, client‑centered advocacy, innovative policy reform, and cross‑sector community education. Founded in Cincinnati in 1997, OJPC is a statewide nonprofit law office focused on reducing incarceration, improving conditions inside prisons, and expanding freedom and opportunity for people impacted by the criminal legal system. Learn more about OJPC’s mission by visiting: https://ohiojpc.org/ https://www.linkedin.com/company/ohio-justice-&-policy-center/ Part-time, non-exempt position: 20-25 hours per week. Salary range: $26,000-$28,000, commensurate with experience. Join our dedicated team and help create second chances across Ohio. Apply online today! Employer is EOE/M/F/D/V. No third‑party candidates please. #ZR
